about: Release / announcement calendar for the event rule: within window_days before a major event (on the day itself too), a Buy-zone price shows as Watch on the site and the evaluation skill won't call Buy, unless the price is at Definitely-buy. scope "all" = every card; a list of set codes (e.g. ["M6a"]) = only cards from those sets. Events with d = null are rumoured/undated: listed, never applied. Edit with scripts/events.py.
